messages:
Sam: quick check — putting up a tiny smoke test of the launch post snippets on the staging landing page. can folks scan the headers/CTAs for tone? :eyes:
Elaine: great, where's the link?
Sam: https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-snippets — password: redwood-test (don't share externally)
Jordan: looked through headers. suggest swapping 'lightweight inference' -> 'production-grade inference' in hero. sounds stronger for our audience.
Nisha: +1 on production-grade. also the secondary CTA 'try now' feels generic. what about 'start free with credits'?
Mike: 'start free with credits' reads long in the hero button. maybe main: 'Get started' and sublink: 'Free credits' below?
Elaine: mockup looks cramped on mobile. @DesignBot can you nudge the hero padding down 8px?
DesignBot: will update — pushing a small change in 10m.
Sam: tiny content ask: benchmark claim in paragraph 2 says "2x cheaper than X" — LegalBot wants a citation or soften language.
LegalBot: please avoid direct competitor comparisons without evidence. suggest: "cost reductions observed in internal benchmarks" or attach benchmark doc.
Nisha: ok change to "cost reductions in internal benchmarks" and include a footnote link to the benchmark report.
Jordan: also the line about "same API across hosted and private" — can we make it more explicit: "one API for hosted, dedicated, and VPC deployments"? clarity helps legal and enterprise folks.
Sam: agreed, patching that now. I'm going to paste the updated snippet here for quick scan:
Sam: ```
Hero headline: Production-grade inference, priced for scale
Subhead: One API for hosted, dedicated, and VPC deployments — predictable performance and cost controls
Primary CTA: Get started
Secondary: Free credits (link)
Benchmark blurb: Cost reductions observed in internal benchmarks. [Report link]
```
Mike: looks solid. minor nit: headline maybe 'Predictable, production-grade inference' (lead with predictability).
Elaine: mobile spacing fixed in updated mock. pinging design review in #design for final check.
Jordan: wording approved from product side after the two adjustments.
Nisha: marketing approves copy with legal-friendly benchmark wording and CTA tweak.
LegalBot: approved copy with benchmark wording. please attach the benchmark PDF to the CMS entry and keep the phrasing as submitted.
Sam: thanks all. next: can someone tag ops to schedule the final publish window? want to go live Tues 9am PT.
Mike: tagging @Jordan to confirm deploy window with eng-release.
Jordan: I can do Tue 9am PT but will need the final assets by Mon 6pm PT.
Sam: noted. final assets deadline Mon 6pm PT. I'll upload to CMS and ping when done.
Elaine: I'll run the final QA checklist once assets are uploaded.
Sam: done for now — leaving a TODO list below:
Sam: - update hero + CTA copy (done)
Sam: - attach benchmark PDF to CMS (Sam)
Sam: - mobile padding fix (DesignBot)
Sam: - final assets by Mon 6pm PT (Sam/Design)
Sam: - schedule publish window with eng (Jordan)
Sam: thanks everyone :rocket:
DesignBot: small CSS tweak pushed to staging at 1834567935
Sam: quick followup — CMS entry created: https://cms.redwood.ai/entries/launch-post-1834567890 (has draft copy and where to attach the PDF)
Mike: I'll spot-check the live staging link after DesignBot change.
Mike: staging check done — hero looks cleaner on iPhone 12.
Sam: perfect. closing thread, will reopen if anything else pops up.
